assets.displayTitle: Elevated road through the animal city
assets.artistVerification: The official Disney Animation page identifies this as Zootopia (2016) visual-development art but does not name an individual artist. No individual attribution has been inferred.
assets.contrastWithKungFuPanda: A dense invented metropolis and diagonal traffic route provide a useful contrast with open landscape staging and isolated mountain or temple silhouettes.

assets.displayTitle: Warm station hall and stained-glass light
assets.assetType: Environment concept art; earlier station interior design
assets.artistVerification: The artist's own Zootopia portfolio credits its concept images to Matthias Lechner, identifies his role as art director of environments, and introduces this image as a station interior that later changed while retaining the stained-glass window.
assets.copyright: © Walt Disney. All rights reserved. Artwork by Matthias Lechner.
assets.contrastWithKungFuPanda: Use this architectural interior to compare a subdued warm palette, patterned framing, and scale cues with a broad exterior landscape or a strongly simplified color key.

assets.assetType: Visual development art; Tundra Town environment concept
assets.artistVerification: The official Disney Animation page identifies this as Zootopia (2016) Tundra Town visual-development art but does not name an individual artist. No individual attribution has been inferred.
assets.contrastWithKungFuPanda: The cold urban snow palette, rounded buildings, and scattered warm lights are a strong comparison with warm mountain or sunset landscape paintings.
